Annotations.description: Annotations maps metadata keys to implementation- or system-specific values.

DurationShorthand.description: A shorthand representation of time duration, e.g. '1m', '10d', '2w'.

Label.description: A label value that can be either a single string or an array of strings.

Labels.description: Labels maps each metadata key to a set of values.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the object's human-readable name.

labels.description: Labels contains metadata associated with the object.

annotations.description: Annotations contains implementation- or system-specific metadata.

Metadata.description: Metadata identifies and describes an OpenSLO v1 object.

type.description:
Type identifies the implementation-defined metric-source type.
When [SLIMetricSource.MetricSourceRef] is set, OpenSLO infers Type from the referenced [DataSource].

spec.description: Spec contains source-specific query or metric-retrieval configuration.

SLIMetricSource.description: SLIMetricSource identifies a metrics backend and supplies the configuration needed to retrieve a metric.

SLIMetricSpec.description: SLIMetricSpec defines one query used to read metric data for an SLI.

counter.description:
Counter reports whether the queried good, bad, and total metrics are monotonically increasing.
It has no effect when Raw is used.

good.description: Good supplies the numerator for a good-over-total ratio.

bad.description: Bad supplies the number subtracted from Total for a failure-based ratio.

total.description: Total supplies the denominator for a Good- or Bad-based ratio.

rawType.description: RawType selects whether Raw is interpreted as a success or failure ratio when Raw is used.

raw.description: Raw defines a query for a precomputed success or failure ratio.

SLIRatioMetric.description: SLIRatioMetric defines an indicator from good divided by total or (total minus bad) divided by total.

thresholdMetric.description:
ThresholdMetric defines a query that returns raw values.
[SLOObjective.Operator] compares each value with [SLOObjective.Value].

SLISpec.description: SLISpec defines the query or queries used to calculate an SLI.

SLOAlertPolicy.description: An alert policy that can be provided inline or as a reference.

startTime.description: StartTime anchors the first calendar window.

timeZone.description: TimeZone controls the interpretation of StartTime and later boundaries.

SLOCalendar.description: SLOCalendar anchors a calendar-aligned SLOTimeWindow in a time zone.

SLOIndicatorInline.description: SLOIndicatorInline embeds an SLI in an SLOSpec or SLOObjective.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the objective's human-readable name.

op.description: Operator compares threshold-metric samples with Value.

value.description:
Value sets the threshold for metric sample comparisons.
It is distinct from the success target expressed by Target or TargetPercent.

target.description: Target expresses the success target as a fraction.

targetPercent.description: TargetPercent expresses the success target as a percentage.

timeSliceTarget.description: TimeSliceTarget classifies a slice as good when BudgetingMethod is [SLOBudgetingMethodTimeslices].

timeSliceWindow.description:
TimeSliceWindow sets the slice size and query interval.
It applies to [SLOBudgetingMethodTimeslices] and [SLOBudgetingMethodRatioTimeslices].
This Go model supports [DurationShorthand] only.
OpenSLO also permits a number, which it interprets as minutes.

indicator.description: Indicator defines this objective's SLI inline for a composite SLO.

indicatorRef.description: IndicatorRef names this objective's [SLI] for a composite SLO.

compositeWeight.description:
CompositeWeight scales this objective's contribution to a composite SLO.
OpenSLO defaults it to 1, but this SDK preserves an omitted value as nil.

SLOObjective.description: SLOObjective defines a success target and, when applicable, a threshold comparison or composite-specific indicator.

service.description:
Service names the associated service.
Consumers define how to resolve the name to a [Service].

indicator.description:
Indicator defines a standard SLO's SLI inline.
Composite SLOs place indicators on individual Objectives.

indicatorRef.description:
IndicatorRef names an existing [SLI] for a standard SLO.
Composite SLOs place indicator references on individual Objectives.

budgetingMethod.description: BudgetingMethod applies the selected error-budget calculation to every objective.

timeWindow.description: TimeWindow defines the period over which the SLO is evaluated.

objectives.description: Objectives contains the SLO's target definitions.

alertPolicies.description: AlertPolicies contains inline alert policies or references to existing [AlertPolicy] objects.

SLOSpec.description: SLOSpec defines the service association, indicator placement, budgeting method, evaluation window, objectives, and alert policies of an SLO.

duration.description: Duration is the length of the evaluation window.

isRolling.description: IsRolling selects a rolling window when true and a calendar-aligned window when false.

calendar.description: Calendar defines the alignment of a calendar window.

SLOTimeWindow.description: SLOTimeWindow defines one rolling or calendar-aligned evaluation window.

description: SLO represents a target value or range for a service level measured by an SLI.
